from sympy import oo, nan
from sympy.polys.domains import EXRAW
from sympy.polys.matrices.sdm import SDM

# Test case: SDM with implicit zero multiplied by oo should give nan but gives 0
result = SDM({}, (1, 1), EXRAW).mul(oo)

buggy.sdm_mul_mixed_zoo:
from sympy import oo, zoo, nan
from sympy.polys.domains import EXRAW
from sympy.polys.matrices.sdm import SDM

# Test case: mixed matrix [[5, 0], [0, oo]] * zoo

    probe('zero_times_zoo', float(result_dense[0, 1]))

    probe('zero_times_zoo', 0.0)
